tools.name: get_meeting_recordings
tools.title: Get meeting recordings
tools.description: List the recordings of the video meeting behind a conference link (the url get_event_conference returns), newest first, among those the current user can open. For one occurrence of a recurring event, pass the occurrence's start as recorded_from and its end as recorded_to; leave both out for every recording of the series. The 10 newest recordings also list the chapters of their transcript (start in seconds, time, title) and the names of its speakers: use them to pick the recording and the chapter the question is about, then read only that part with get_transcript_excerpt (the recording's documentId and the chapter's number, 1 for the first listed, or a time range). Read the whole transcript with get_document_transcription_by_id only when no chapter fits. An empty list comes with a reason: NO_RECORDING (the meeting was not recorded, or its recording is not saved yet) or OTHER_PROVIDER (the link is not an eXo video meeting, e.g. Teams or Zoom). To find which of several meetings was recorded, pass them all as meetings instead of conference_url (at most 20): each comes back with its recording_count, or the reason it has none; then call again with the chosen meeting's conference_url and window to list its recordings. A meeting that has no recording here was not recorded: never summarize it.

conference_url.description: The meeting link, as get_event_conference or get_agenda_events returns it. Required unless meetings is given.

recorded_from.description: Optional. Earliest recording date: an RFC3339 date-time (2026-10-23T09:00:00Z) or a date yyyy-MM-dd (2026-10-23, the start of that day in UTC). Nothing else is accepted: resolve a relative expression such as 'yesterday' or 'last week' into such a date yourself.

recorded_to.description: Optional. End of the meeting or occurrence: an RFC3339 date-time (2026-10-23T10:00:00Z) or a date yyyy-MM-dd (2026-10-23, the end of that day in UTC); recordings saved shortly after it still count. Nothing else is accepted: resolve a relative expression such as 'yesterday' into such a date yourself.

meetings.description: Optional, instead of conference_url: the meetings to check at once, at most 20, each with its conference_url and the occurrence's start and end as recorded_from and recorded_to, copied as get_agenda_events gives them.
